steps.what: Present designs and reports to customers or design committees
Discuss the need for modification and clarify the customer's approval or reservations

tasks.design: Keep presentation and modification discussion with the designer. The design version in {DOCS} anchors the discussion; no separate slide assembly or approval-chasing baseline is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Customers need to understand trade-offs and explain reservations in context.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes a reduction in these interactions.
tasks.still_hard: A favorable response may contain conditions that change the design brief.
tasks.human_edge: Explain trade-offs and distinguish agreement from unresolved reservations.
tasks.altitude: Customer contact and design responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Present a design rationale to a client
reach.learn: How to make unresolved trade-offs explicit

evidence.claim: Design presentation and negotiation of modifications remain interpersonal judgement work; no separate repeatable preparation share is established.

assumptions: Boundary is presentation and response clarification, excluding design creation, report production and actual customer approval labour. The customer or committee retains approval authority outside this focal denominator unchanged.

The designer supplies the design and report before s1. The customer or committee produces its response after presentation and during s2 before the designer clarifies and records it; capture is counted within s2. No free approved-design flag is assumed.
Native version access precedes code. No new service or transferred work is proposed; incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Current design approval scope and response recording practice
research_questions: Which customer conditions are commonly discovered only after a design presentation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Presentation and customer clarification retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Direct and coordinate fabrication of models and drafting of working drawings from sketches

tasks.design: Keep fabrication direction and drawing clarification with the designer. Sketches in {DOCS} support coordination; fabrication and drafting performed by other roles are not counted as designer time saved.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sketches leave physical and dimensional questions requiring interpretation with makers and drafters.
tasks.enabler_now: No separate clerical coordination baseline or automatic fabrication capability is established here.
tasks.still_hard: A drawing can be precise while misrepresenting the intended form or user experience.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguity between design intent, physical models and working specifications.
tasks.altitude: Coordination responsibilities and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How to expose physical constraints before final fabrication

evidence.claim: Directing fabrication and drafting is distinct from generating images or digital prototypes; no supported reduction in the coordination action is established.

assumptions: Boundary is the designer's direction and coordination, excluding makers' fabrication and drafters' drawing production. Their work stays unchanged outside focal time.

The designer produces sketches and model requirements before coordination. Makers and drafters produce questions and progress evidence during s1 before directions are confirmed; the designer's verification and capture remain within its full time. No structured fabrication-ready flag is supplied free.
Native sketch sharing precedes code. No new service or work transfer is proposed; upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Who fabricates models and produces drawings
research_questions: Which sketch ambiguities require repeated direct clarification with makers?

already_counted.description: Direction, question resolution and instruction capture

approvals.approved_version: Exact sketch version, model requirements, drawing question resolution and direction communicated; revisions require a new direction.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Other-role fabrication and drafting are neither removed nor counted as focal savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Investigate documented product characteristics, production constraints and market evidence

loop.purpose: Compare statements in the selected product evidence
loop.output: Comparison with exact source passages and explicit gaps
loop.check: Designer reads every cited passage and checks whether it concerns the same product, conditions and meaning
loop.stop: One comparison and one correction; missing or unsupported evidence returns to manual research
loop.why_not_simpler: Different documents describe handling, manufacturing and appeal in varying language

steps.what: Investigate handling, use, distribution and maintenance through observation and specialist discussion
Assess product safety, appeal and production implications against the collected evidence

tasks.design: Use bounded source comparison in {DOCS} for the documentary part of product investigation. Keep direct observation, specialist discussion and safety or feasibility interpretation with people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing statements across product evidence consumes reading and organizing time.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-bounded comparison can surface relevant passages for designer verification.
tasks.still_hard: Marketing statements and laboratory evidence may concern different operating conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge which evidence applies to the actual product and what requires physical testing.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less documentary comparison; product judgement and testing responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Investigate handling and maintenance of a physical design
reach.learn: How actual use changes material and form requirements

evidence.claim: A bounded comparison of selected documents can assist product investigation; this is an E1 design rather than a measured industrial-design case or safety verification capability.

assumptions: Boundary is product characteristics investigation, excluding certification, engineering validation and new production implementation. Specialist participation stays unchanged outside the focal denominator.

The designer selects source versions and defines product ID, conditions and questions within s1's retained 22.5 hours, including all source retrieval, citation checking and manual fallback. The model proposes comparisons rather than consuming a free safety, appeal or manufacturability flag. Specialists and observations produce findings during s2 before s3 interpretation.
Test native approved document search and comparison before code. Missing sources require manual investigation; no autonomous web research or physical test substitution is proposed.
unknowns: Share of investigation spent comparing existing documents
Quality and availability of product-specific sources
research_questions: Does source comparison reduce reading time after all citations and operating conditions are checked?

already_counted.description: Source selection, capture, verification and comparison correction

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=92.5, gross=7.5, upkeep=5, net=2.5. Range 0-1 allows mainly physical investigation or extensive document qualification checks.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop manufacturing procedures for the design with production specialists
Monitor manufacture in the factory and assess operations and product quality improvements

tasks.design: Keep procedure development and factory observation with the designer and production specialists. {DOCS} holds the procedure, but no routine reporting or control-system change is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Design intent must be reconciled with physical production conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported separate documentation or monitoring-copying baseline is established.
tasks.still_hard: A process can meet a drawing while creating poor usability, finish or maintainability.
tasks.human_edge: Observe physical outcomes and recognize improvements that matter to product quality.
tasks.altitude: Procedure contribution and factory monitoring remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review fabrication outcomes against design intent
reach.learn: How production constraints change achievable form and finish

evidence.claim: Procedure development and physical production observation remain judgement work; no new automated quality decision or drafting baseline is established.

assumptions: Boundary is designer procedure contribution and monitoring, excluding production execution, engineering authorization and quality certification. Those actors retain existing effort outside focal time.

Production specialists supply constraints during s1. The production manager and responsible engineer authorize the procedure after s1 and before the associated production observed in s2; their unchanged review is outside this denominator. Operators and physical production produce observations during s2 before recommendations close. No free production-ready or quality-pass flag is assumed.
Native procedure access precedes code. No new tool or transferred work is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Production authorization and designer observation scope
research_questions: Which quality issues require the designer's direct factory observation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and net=0 with zero upkeep. Physical monitoring and manufacturing judgement retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Document comparison may shrink slightly; customer presentation, maker coordination and factory judgement retain their time.
reach: Exchange physical design review methods with a set and exhibit designer
role.ambitious_version: A designer who connects traceable research with direct understanding of users, makers and factory outcomes.
